Working notes — desk routing

Observed outcomes:
- C (regional office) accepted:
  - small shipment, south (REQ-2401)
  - large refund, north (REQ-2405)
- C rejected:
  - small refund, south (REQ-2400)
  - large invoice, east (REQ-2402)
  - claims: large east, large south, small north, small east (REQ-2403/06/07/08/09)
- A rejected:
  - small refund, north (REQ-2404)

Current rules/tendencies:
- Claims: do not choose C. Likely B (priority desk), but not confirmed.
- Invoices: do not choose C. Likely B, but not confirmed.
- Small refunds: C and A are invalid. Try B next.
- Large refunds: C is valid.
- Shipments: C is valid, at least for small/south; likely regional office routing.

No clear evidence that region, sender, or urgency wording alone determines routing. Type + size appear more important.

Next decision policy:
- Claim or invoice: try B first; record outcome.
- Small refund: try B.
- Large refund: use C.
- Shipment: use C.

Keep testing B for claims/invoices/small refunds to confirm. Avoid repeating known invalid choices: C for claims/invoices/small refunds; A for small refunds.

Working notes — desk routing

Observed:
- C accepted: small shipment south; large refund north (REQ-2405/17).
- C rejected: small refund south; large invoice east; claims large east/south, small north/east; large refund south (REQ-2416).
- A rejected: small refund north.
- B accepted: small claim north (REQ-2412/18); large invoice east (REQ-2414).
- B rejected: small claim south (REQ-2410/13/19); small claim east (REQ-2411); large invoice south (REQ-2415).

Rules:
- Small claims: north -> B valid. South/east -> B invalid. C invalid for small north/east; C unknown for small south. Try A for small south/east; if A fails for south, try C.
- Large invoices: east -> B valid; south -> B invalid. C invalid for large east. Try A then C for large south.
- Large refunds: north -> C valid; south -> C invalid. Try A/B for large south.
- Small refunds: A invalid at least north; C invalid at least south; B unconfirmed.
- Shipments: C valid, at least small/south.

Type + size + region matter. Sender and urgency wording do not appear decisive.

Next policy:
- Small claim north: B.
- Small claim south/east: try A.
- Large invoice east: B; large invoice south: try A, then C.
- Large refund north: C; large refund south: try A/B.
- Small refund: try B; record.
- Shipment: C.

Avoid known invalid: C for small refund south, large invoice east, claims large east/south and small north/east, large refund south; A for small refund north; B for small claim south/east, large invoice south.

Working notes — desk routing

Confirmed:
- C valid: large refund north; small shipment south.
- C invalid: small shipment north; small refund south; large invoice east/north; large refund south; claims large east/south and small north/east.
- A invalid: small refund north; large refund south; large invoice south.
- B valid: small claim north; large invoice east.
- B invalid: small claim south/east; large invoice south.

Rules by type/size/region:
- Small claims: north -> B. South/east -> B invalid; C invalid north/east, unknown south; try A.
- Large invoices: east -> B. South -> A and B invalid; C unconfirmed, try C. North -> C invalid; try A/B.
- Large refunds: north -> C. South -> C and A invalid; try B.
- Small refunds: A invalid north; C invalid south; B unconfirmed; try B and record.
- Shipments: small/south -> C. Small/north -> C invalid; try A/B.

Sender and urgency wording not decisive. Type + size + region matter.

Next policy:
- Small claim north: B.
- Small claim south/east: A.
- Large invoice east: B; south: C; north: A/B.
- Large refund north: C; south: B.
- Small refund: B; record.
- Shipment: small/south C; small/north A/B.

Avoid known invalid:
C for small shipment north, small refund south, large invoice east/north, large refund south, claims large east/south and small north/east.
A for small refund north, large refund south, large invoice south.
B for small claim south/east, large invoice south.

- C: large refund north; small shipment south; small invoice south.

- A: small refund north; large refund south; large invoice south; small invoice north.
- B: small claim south/east; large invoice south; large shipment north.
- D: large claim north (not an option).

Rules by type/size/region:
- Small claims: north -> B. South/east -> A.
- Small refunds: north -> B. Other regions unconfirmed; C invalid south. Try B and record.
- Large refunds: north -> C; south -> B.
- Large invoices: east -> B; south -> C; north -> A/B.
- Small invoices: south -> C; north -> B/C.
- Shipments: small/south -> C; small/north -> A; large/north -> A/C.

Sender and urgency wording not decisive. Type + size + region matter.

Next policy:
- Small claim north: B; east/south: A.
- Small refund north: B; elsewhere try B and record.
- Large refund north: C; south: B.
- Large invoice east: B; south: C; north: A/B.
- Small invoice south: C; north: B/C.
- Shipment small/south C; small/north A; large/north A/C.

Avoid known invalid:

Working notes — desk routing

- C: large refund north; small shipment south; small invoice south; large shipment south/north.
- A: small claim east; small shipment north.

- B: small claim south/east; large invoice south; large shipment north; large refund east.
- C: small shipment north; small refund south; large invoice east/north; large refund south; large claim east/south; small claim north/east.

Rules:
- Claims: small north B; small south/east A. Large south/east not C.
- Refunds: small north B. Large north C; south B; east not B (try C/A).
- Invoices: small south C; north B. Large east B; south C; north B.
- Shipments: small south C; north A. Large south C; north C.

Next policy:
- Small claim north B; south/east A.
- Small refund north B; elsewhere try B and record.
- Large refund north C; south B; east try C then A.
- Small invoice south C; north B.
- Large invoice east B; south C; north B.
- Shipment small/south C; small/north A; large/south C; large/north C.

Avoid known invalid by option as listed above.

Working notes — desk routing

Confirmed valid:

- B: small claim south/east; large invoice south; large shipment north; large refund east.

Rules:
- Claims: small north B; small south/east A. Large: south invalid A/C; north/east invalid C; try B.
- Refunds: small north B; small south B. Large north C; south B; east try C then A, not B.
- Invoices: small south C; north B. Large east/north B; south invalid A/B/C.
- Shipments: small south C; north A. Large south C; north invalid A/B/C.

Next policy:
- Small claim north B; south/east A.
- Small refund north/south B; elsewhere try B and record.
- Large refund north C; south B; east try C then A.
- Small invoice south C; north B.
- Large invoice east/north B; south avoid A/B/C and flag.
- Shipment small/south C; small/north A; large/south C; large/north avoid A/B/C and flag.
- Large claim: try B unless later evidence; avoid A south, C north/east/south.

Avoid known invalid by option as listed above.

Working notes — desk routing

Confirmed valid:
- B: small claim north; small invoice north; large invoice east/north; large refund south.
- C: large refund north; small invoice south; small shipment south; large shipment south.
- A: small shipment north; small claim east.
- D: large invoice south.

Confirmed invalid:
- A: small refund north; large refund south; large invoice south/north; small invoice north; large shipment north; large claim south.
- B: small claim south/east; large invoice south; large shipment north; large refund east.
- C: small shipment north; small refund south; large invoice east/north/south; large refund south/east; large claim east/south/north; small claim north/east; large shipment north.

Rules / next policy:
- Claims: small north B; small south/east A. Large try B unless later evidence; avoid A south, C north/east/south.
- Refunds: small north/south B; elsewhere try B and record. Large north C; south B. Large east: C rejected; try A next, not B.
- Invoices: small north B; small south C. Large east/north B; large south D, avoid A/B/C.
- Shipments: small north A; small south C; large south C; large north avoid A/B/C and flag.
- Avoid known invalid by option as listed above.

New evidence:
- Large invoice south: D accepted.
- Large refund east: C rejected twice; A still untested.
